title: Normalized correlated sign sum
statement: For $\rho\in[-1,1]$ and a natural number $n$, take $n$ independent vectors, each with the correlated sign vector distribution at parameter $\rho$, sum them, and scale the result by $1/\sqrt n$. The resulting probability distribution on the correlation plane is the normalized correlated sign sum measure.
